Changes at a glance

Exact-text comparison. Empty fields display as “(empty)”; a missing row displays as “Not present”.
ParameterStatusBeforeAfterReview

JSON preserves exact text. The spreadsheet CSV prefixes formula-like cells with an apostrophe for safer opening. Original files are unchanged. Blank values are permitted; this review does not establish experimental completeness.

File format and comparison rules

UTF-8 CSV, up to 250,000 bytes and 1,000 data rows per file. Use this exact header:

parameter,value,unit,notes

Every row needs four fields and a unique, non-blank parameter. Values, units and notes may be blank. Quotes, embedded commas and line breaks are supported. Parameter names are exact, case-sensitive identifiers: “Temperature” and “temperature” are different parameters. Spaces are preserved.

RunDelta compares text, not physical equivalence. “1” and “1.0” differ; “mV” and “V” trigger a unit mismatch. No unit conversion, numerical interpretation or automatic correction is performed. Resolve duplicates or malformed records in the source before comparing.

Files are processed locally in this browser tab, without uploads or analytics. Reloading or clearing the workspace removes the session data. Saved reports and originals remain wherever you downloaded them.
